nodes.label: CC0 1.0 Licence
nodes.rationale: Public-domain packs chosen so placeholder art needs no attribution, though credit is given anyway.

nodes.label: Single JSON File Storage (Store + AtomicFile)
nodes.rationale: A personal budget is a few thousand records a year, so whole state lives in a StateFlow and is rewritten atomically; no DAOs, migrations or annotation processor. Ceiling: move to Room past ~10k transactions.

nodes.label: No DI Framework / No HTTP Library
nodes.rationale: One App object holds the store; HttpURLConnection plus kotlinx.serialization cover Sheets and AI REST calls.
nodes.norm_label: no di framework / no http library

nodes.label: Money as Long Minor Units
nodes.rationale: Exact integer arithmetic; decimal places come from java.util.Currency.defaultFractionDigits so JPY has none.

nodes.label: Largest-Remainder Allocation
nodes.rationale: Guarantees item costs and split shares always sum exactly to the total in minor units.

nodes.label: My Share Counts as Spent
nodes.rationale: Tracks consumption rather than cash leaving the account; assumed default awaiting user confirmation.

nodes.label: Daily Budget
nodes.rationale: Fixed for the whole day; overspend today automatically lowers tomorrow's budget.

nodes.label: Monthly Pacing
nodes.rationale: Status always shown as text plus colour, never colour alone (accessibility).

nodes.label: Receipt Per-Item Tax/Service Allocation
nodes.rationale: AI/parser only extracts printed values; all arithmetic in Receipt.kt. Never invent tax or service charge; mismatched totals are flagged for user correction rather than guessed.

nodes.label: Currency from Country
nodes.rationale: Prefilled from SIM/network via TelephonyManager, falling back to locale, so no location permission is needed.

nodes.label: Pre-Funded Trips
nodes.rationale: Trip spending draws from its own fund set aside in the period, so it is excluded from monthly and daily budget.

nodes.label: Receipt Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Images never leave the phone; only OCR text reaches an AI provider.

nodes.label: ML Kit On-Device Text Recognition
nodes.rationale: Bundled model works offline and keeps images on device.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Receipt Parser (ReceiptText.kt)
nodes.rationale: Fallback that always works with no AI provider or when a call fails.

nodes.label: AI Provider Presets (OpenAI-compatible chat/completions)
nodes.rationale: All providers expose an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so one client plus a preset table; called directly from the phone since a desktop relay would need a laptop running.

nodes.label: drive.file OAuth Scope
nodes.rationale: Non-sensitive scope replaces PRD's spreadsheets scope: no Google verification and no weekly re-consent. Trade-off: app cannot write to hand-made sheets.

nodes.label: AuthorizationClient (Play Services)
nodes.rationale: Account choice and Sheets grant in one step; Play Services holds the refresh token so the app never stores one.

nodes.label: Glance Home-Screen Widgets
nodes.rationale: Refreshed on every save and just after midnight; no periodic polling so no refresh-rate setting. Tiny layout fits 1x1 cells and cover screens.

nodes.label: Drop-In Drawable Replacement
nodes.rationale: PNGs dropped into drawable-nodpi with the listed name replace placeholders with no code change; drawn small and upscaled nearest-neighbour.

nodes.label: Provider Names as Text, No Logos
nodes.rationale: Claude, Gemini, OpenAI logos are trademarks.
nodes.norm_label: provider names as text, no logos

nodes.label: OAuth Consent Screen (External, Published)
nodes.rationale: With only non-sensitive scopes, publishing needs no review and sign-ins don't expire weekly.

nodes.label: Android OAuth Client (package + SHA-1)
nodes.rationale: Google matches package name and signing key, so no client ID is pasted into the app.
